fix.symptom: The Host settings page shifts its whole content sideways whenever the vertical scrollbar appears or disappears.
fix.cause: The settings pane scrolls in a Host container that does not reserve the scrollbar gutter; only one dropdown in the Host frontend CSS uses scrollbar-gutter: stable.
fix.change: While the Context settings section is mounted, src/stable-gutter.ts reserves scrollbar-gutter: stable on the nearest scrolling ancestor and restores the previous inline value on unmount. Host stylesheets are untouched; the reservation is skipped when the Host already gutters the container or the view exposes no getComputedStyle resolver.
fix.scope: Settings section only; the Context inspector view is unchanged.

settingsSuite.note: Includes the first-run failure of the hook on a stubbed window (getComputedStyle missing) that the guard now tolerates.

fullSuite.note: Rerun before the 0.10.11 UI changes; all 11 signed-runtime native-addon failures are absent. A representative failure was separately reproduced under the signed DSH Node runtime; native persistence/idle checks passed 25/25 under standard Node.

initialSignedRuntimeRun.failureCause: All 11 failures are node-addon-system ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED (local native module code-signature Team ID mismatch), reproduced on a clean e381e09 worktree without these changes; not regressions.

nativeInstallation.note: The client bundle is loaded per Host start; the running Host still exposes 0.10.9 until it restarts.

scope: The original installation and signed-runtime result are historical. Follow-up validation resolves the 11 environment failures and verifies 0.10.10 settings geometry. The separately versioned 0.10.11 adds the visual history UI.
